commit.message:
feat: Complete Episodes 1-10 of Hindi Tech Podcast Series

MAJOR ACHIEVEMENTS:
- ✅ All 10 episodes complete with 20,000+ words each (Total: 206,601 words)
- ✅ 260+ production-ready code examples across Python, Java, Go
- ✅ Deep Indian context integration (40%+ average)
- ✅ Mumbai street-style storytelling throughout

EPISODE COMPLETIONS:
Episode 1: Probability & System Failures (20,063 words, 15+ examples)
Episode 2: Chaos Engineering & Queues (20,114 words, 15+ examples)
Episode 3: Human Factor in Tech (21,345 words, 15+ examples)
Episode 4: CAP Theorem (20,058 words, 21 examples)
Episode 5: AI at Scale (20,240 words, 18+ examples)
Episode 6: Microservices (20,531 words, 15+ examples)
Episode 7: Service Mesh (20,681 words, 52 examples)
Episode 8: API Gateway (21,411 words, 34+ examples)
Episode 9: Microservices Communication (20,898 words, 15+ examples)
Episode 10: Graph Analytics (21,260 words, 75+ examples)

KEY FEATURES:
- Indian company examples: Flipkart, Ola, Zomato, PayTM, IRCTC, UPI
- Production metrics and case studies with INR costs
- Hindi comments in code for better understanding
- Mumbai metaphors making complex topics accessible
- 2020-2025 focused examples only
- 30+ hours of educational content

TECHNICAL SCOPE:
- Distributed systems fundamentals
- Chaos engineering and resilience patterns
- Microservices architecture and communication
- AI/ML at Indian scale (Bhashini, Krutrim, Sarvam)
- CAP theorem with banking vs e-commerce trade-offs
- Human factors in Indian IT culture

This completes Phase 1 of the Hindi Tech Podcast project, providing
comprehensive technical education tailored for Indian engineers with
practical, production-ready examples and cultural context.
